goals: Close the first-live-dispatch observability gap described in design/selfhost-iteration-v0.md section 2.2.

In src/orchestration/queue-runner.ts, allocate a safe run id before invoking the Supervisor for a start action, persist it to the queue item's lastRunId and runIds together with status=running and the attempt increment, and pass that exact id to the injected runner. A process crash after this persistence must leave a durable run binding.

In src/supervisor/cli.ts, add a backward-compatible --run-id option to supervisor start. Use it when present; otherwise retain random UUID generation. Let the existing manifest store validate id safety and reject collisions. Keep resume behavior unchanged.
Update createQueueSupervisorRunner so a real start passes the preallocated id via --run-id and a resume passes its existing --run argument.

Handle a start that fails before creating a manifest without fabricating evidence: if the preallocated manifest is absent after the runner returns or throws, allow the queue item to retry with nextAction=start rather than leaving a permanently dangling resume. If a manifest exists, preserve the binding even on interruption.
Keep the RunManifest as task authority and the queue as dispatch coordination. Do not infer a live run from active.json when an explicit id is available.

Add focused tests in tests/queue-run-binding.test.ts that prove: persisted lastRunId is visible inside the runner before it returns; the request and manifest use the same id; supervisor start honors --run-id; a crash-like start with a durable manifest can be reconciled; and a start failure before manifest creation falls back safely to start.
Add docs/evidence/QUEUE_RUN_BINDING.md with implementation facts, exact tests, compatibility behavior, and remaining limits.
nonGoals: Do not implement parallel queue dispatch, a daemon, push, or automatic main-branch merge.
Do not rewrite historical queue records.
Do not change RunManifest version or TaskContract shape.
Do not change path-audit, deadline, budget, estimator, or runtime files.
deliverables: A queue item is durably bound to its first run id before worker execution.
The same id is passed to Supervisor start and stored in RunManifest.
Failure before manifest creation does not strand the item on resume.
forbidden: Do not persist a guessed run id from active.json.
Do not create a manifest merely to make a binding look successful.
Do not touch files outside writePaths.

goals: Close the failed-exit and reused-worktree path-scope gap described in design/selfhost-iteration-v0.md section 2.3.

Add a small shared path-scope audit utility under src/agents/path-scope.ts. It must reject path traversal and absolute paths, normalize repository-relative separators, treat exact writePaths and descendants of directory-like writePaths as allowed, and return bounded evidence listing changed paths and paths outside write scope.
Extend AgentResult with optional changedPathsError so adapters can expose a git-diff failure without losing the original worker failure.
Update Claude and Codex adapters to set changedPathsError whenever collectChangedPaths fails.

In src/repair/loop.ts, evaluate a path audit after every worker exit, not only successful exits. Preserve the adapter's original structured failure when a failed exit also has path overshoot; path overshoot must be separate durable evidence and must never relabel budget/auth/provider failures.

Add a bounded PathAuditRecord in src/supervisor/types.ts and persist pathAudits on RunTaskState. The evidence should include attempt index, observed time, worker exit code, changed paths, outside-write-scope paths, and any changed-path collection error. Keep records cumulative for the task so retries do not erase prior audit evidence; cap stored path counts.
Update src/supervisor/store.ts to validate optional pathAudits while keeping old manifests readable and failing closed on malformed present records.

In src/scheduler/codex-batch.ts, checkpoint path audit evidence for accepted and rejected worker results. Before dispatching a reused rejected worktree, collect changes from its recorded base and audit them against the contract; if any path is outside scope or collection fails, fail closed before starting the worker and report the exact evidence. Do not auto-delete or hide unexpected files.

Add focused tests in tests/worker-exit-path-audit.test.ts covering failed exit with outside-scope temp file, preserved original failure, accepted audits, invalid traversal evidence, manifest validation, and reused-worktree rejection before worker invocation.
Add docs/evidence/WORKER_EXIT_PATH_AUDIT.md describing behavior, tests, and why automatic cleanup is forbidden.
nonGoals: Do not implement deadline extension or budget continuation.
Do not run runtime services during the audit.
Do not change queue run-id binding files.
Do not make path evidence grant acceptance or change verifier authority.
deliverables: Every adapter worker exit produces bounded path-scope evidence.
A failed worker keeps its original failure while path overshoot remains visible separately.
A reused worktree is audited before its next worker starts and fails closed on unexpected files.
forbidden: Do not overwrite a budget/auth/provider failure with a path failure.
Do not clean or stage unexpected files automatically.
Do not touch files outside writePaths.
